bio: Joshua Gall has worked as a brass specialist and drill designer for several DCI corps. He was a member and brass specialist for The Cadets and has been on staff with the Bluecoats. He designed drill for Genesis Drum Corps. Gall is also co-founder of Ultimate Drill Book and has served as Director of the Longhorn Pep Band and Assistant Director of the Longhorn Band at the University of Texas at Austin.

Justin Mons aged out of the Arizona Academy in 2012 and joined the Mandarins visual staff in 2013, helping improve their visual proficiency score from 23rd to 7th by 2019. He served as assistant caption head for the Mandarins from 2014 to 2016 and became drill designer for the Govenaires in 2023, where the corps took bronze at DCA finals. He is currently Artistic Director of the Govenaires Winter percussion ensemble and appears on the Blue Knights staff as a visual technician.

Justin Robards is an educator and audio engineer with over 20 years of experience. In DCI, he has worked with the Bluecoats and The Academy, among others. He served as an Audio Engineer for the Bluecoats in 2023.

Lauren Casey-Clyde has worked with the Bluecoats as head baritone/trombone instructor since 2023, helping them win the Jim Ott Award for highest brass performance. She has also worked with Santa Clara Vanguard, Pacific Crest, and Blue Devils B in the marching arts since 2018.

Lauryn Heller served as Visual Coordinator, Color Guard Designer and Caption Supervisor for the Bushwackers. She marched with The Cadets Color Guard from 2008 to 2013 and later instructed The Cadets in 2014 and 2015. Heller was a color guard instructor for the Blue Knights Drum and Bugle Corps from 2016 through 2019.

Mason Barnes is a Jackson, MS native currently living in Houston, TX, and serves as the color guard director at William B Travis HS. His previous teaching experience includes Music City Drum and Bugle Corps, and he was returning to Blue Knights for his fourth summer.

Noe Gomez is a visual designer and educator in the marching arts from Los Angeles, California. He performed with Santa Clara Vanguard (serving as drum major 2012–2015), Santa Clara Vanguard Cadets, and Impulse. He served on the visual staff and as Assistant Visual Caption Head of Santa Clara Vanguard, as Visual Design Assistant for Phantom Regiment in 2023, and joined Blue Knights as Visual Designer in 2024.
Patrick Forrester is the Visual Caption Manager for The Cavaliers Drum and Bugle Corps.

Peter Inglett is a Fitness Coordinator who has served on the visual staff of the Colts, Cadets, and Spirit of Atlanta drum corps. He marched baritone with Southwind for five seasons starting in 2003 and euphonium with the Phantom Regiment during their 2008 championship season. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Exercise Science and a Master of Science in Education from Jacksonville State University and is a Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist.

Randi Miles was a performing member of the Crossmen Drum and Bugle Corps (2001-2004) and the Blue Devils (2005), where she was named Rookie of the Year. She has taught with the Crossmen (2007-2008), the Academy (2010), and the Blue Knights Drum and Bugle Corps (2013-2018), and was hired as corps choreographer for Music City. She holds a B.S. in Dance from Texas State University and an M.F.A. in Dance from Arizona State University.

Randil Jeffreys was a performing member of The Cavaliers from 2003 until aging out in 2008. He has taught drum corps as a caption head with Colt Cadets, The Blue Knights, Music City, and The Cavaliers. He studied Music Education at the University of Houston, Euphonium Performance at Idaho State University, and earned a Masters of Arts in Brass Performance at the University of Iowa.

Ron Hardin is a drum corps visual designer and instructor who performed with the Star of Indiana from 1991 to 1992. He served as Visual Caption Head for Carolina Crown, the Canton Bluecoats, and the Santa Clara Vanguard, and designed visual programs for drum corps including Legends and Pioneer. He has also served as a visual judge for Winter Guard International since 1999 and works as Regional Sales Manager for Stanbury Uniforms.

Sean Gordon marched as a mallet percussionist with Pulse Percussion, Impulse Drum and Bugle Corps, and the Blue Devils. He served as front ensemble instructor for The Mandarins (2010), The Academy (2011–2012), and the Blue Devils (2013–2018), and arranged for Gold Drum & Bugle Corps.

Susan Hanggi served as Color Guard Caption Head for the Madison Scouts in 2015, having been on their color guard staff since 2012. She marched with the Santa Clara Vanguard (2004-2005) and Phantom Regiment (2006), and has taught color guard on the staffs of Phantom Regiment (2008), Carolina Crown (2009-2011), and their respective winter guards. She holds a Bachelors from Kennesaw State University and a Masters from the University of North Texas, and teaches at Guyer High School in Texas where she also directs the color guard.

Thomas Claesen is a Belgian-born percussion educator who has taught quadlines for The Cavaliers (2012-2013), Blue Knights (2017-2019), Mandarins (2022), and Carolina Crown (2023). He marched drum corps with The Academy (2008-2009), Santa Clara Vanguard (2010), and The Cavaliers (2011). Claesen has been on staff with Rhythm X since 2018 and launched Quadlingual, an educational resource for marching tenors, in 2025.

Aaron Farris has been involved in drum corps since 2011, starting as a bass drum performer with the Canton Bluecoats. He has worked as a battery technician for the Madison Scouts (2017-2018), the Blue Stars (2019-2022), and the Colts, where he returned for his fourth season. Since 2020 he has served as Percussion Caption Head of the Cincinnati Tradition Drum & Bugle Corps. He also works with high school band programs in the Nashville area.

Adam Chrobak is the Executive Director of Guardians Drum and Bugle Corps. He previously served as Visual Caption Head and staff for Guardians, and spent time with Santa Clara Vanguard. He was featured on FloMarching's On The 50 discussing his path to becoming a corps director.

Brandon Wickham is an international visual designer, clinician, and drill writer from California. He began his marching career with the Vanguard Cadets (2004) and Blue Devils (2005), and has since served as Visual Caption Head for the Academy (2014), visual staff for the Blue Devils, drill designer for Minnesota Brass (2018), and visual consultant for the Madison Scouts (2020). He has designed for award-winning high school programs throughout California and the Midwest, as well as international ensembles in Asia and Europe.

Chad Huel served as a Brass Tech for the Madison Scouts in 2019. He has also taught the Colts, Crossmen, and Genesis Drum and Bugle Corps. He holds a B.Mus.Ed from the University of Regina (2000) and has been a music educator in Saskatchewan, including as band director at LeBoldus Catholic High School and past-president of the Saskatchewan Band Association.

Dr. Chip Crotts serves as Director of Jazz Studies and Assistant Director of Bands at Georgia Tech. A GRAMMY-nominated trumpeter, he has taught as a brass instructor with The Cavaliers, Blue Devils, Phantom Regiment, and Spirit of Atlanta, and currently serves as Brass Caption Head for the Blue Devils. He is also active as a clinician and adjudicator for Bands of America, Drum Corps International, and Winter Guard International.

Chris Stanley served as a Brass Tech for the Madison Scouts in 2019. He previously taught as a high brass specialist with the Colts Drum & Bugle Corps (2011–2013), Spirit of Atlanta (2014), and Pacific Crest (2016–2018), and performed with Spirit of New Jersey, Spirit of Atlanta, and the Phantom Regiment. He holds a BA in Trumpet Performance and a Master's in Jazz Studies with a concentration in Studio Production, and resides in New Jersey as a freelance trumpet player and audio engineer.
Kari White was appointed visual caption head for the Boston Crusaders for the 2008 season. She has been involved with many drum corps including the Blue Devils, Cadets, and Carolina Crown.

Levi Chavis marched with the Cavaliers Drum and Bugle Corps as a trumpet player (2002-2004) and later served on their Brass Instructional Staff (2006-2009). He was the Assistant Visual Caption Manager at Santa Clara Vanguard (2010-2015) and Ensemble Coordinator at Madison Scouts (2022-2023). He currently serves as Visual Caption Supervisor at The Cavaliers.

Mike Dow marched bass drum with the Crossmen from 2001 to 2004 and aged out with the Madison Scouts in 2006. He served on the percussion staff of the Troopers (2007–2009), Carolina Crown (2010–2011), and Madison Scouts (2012–2014), and was the 2016 visual caption manager for the Bushwackers. He holds a degree in computer science from Rutgers University.

Mike Huestis is a percussion arranger who has worked with Pacific Crest, Genesis, Raiders, and Crossmen Drum & Bugle Corps. He was the percussion designer for Genesis's 2013 production mOZaic. A published composer, arranger, and Yamaha/Zildjian endorser, he also authored the method book 'Developing the Percussionist-Musician.' Earlier, he marched with Velvet Knights, Freelancers, and Blue Devils.

Rachel Montañez is a colorguard director and freelance graphic designer currently on program staff with Crossmen. She has served on color guard staff with the Madison Scouts and has taught and choreographed for various programs since 2012. She performed with The Long Island Sunrisers, The Connecticut Hurricanes, The Cadets, Alter Ego IW, and Fusion World. She holds a B.S. in Mathematics from Molloy College.

Rob Jett is the color guard co-caption head for the Blue Knights Drum & Bugle Corps. His marching career began with Suncoast Sound (1987-1989) and Magic of Orlando (1990). He served as Color Guard Caption Head for Santa Clara Vanguard (2000-2002) and has held technician/designer/consultant roles for The Academy and Spirit of Atlanta Drum & Bugle Corps.

Shane Choi joined the Bluecoats Brass Educational Team as Lead Brass Instructor - Trumpet in 2023 after previously working for The Cavaliers Drum & Bugle Corps. He holds degrees in Trumpet Performance (B.M.) and Mechanical Engineering (B.S./M.S.) from Northwestern University and teaches students across the world, from Chicago and Houston to Nigeria and Seoul.

Shawn Murphy is a University of North Texas graduate who marched with the Sky Ryders (1992–1993) and the Blue Devils (1994–1996), winning the Mellophone Individual and Ensemble Competition in 1995. He served as a brass instructor with Blue Devils B, the Cadets, the Blue Knights, the Blue Devils, Santa Clara Vanguard, and the Mandarins.

Taylor Ransom served as a visual tech (2014) and bass tech (2015-2016) for the Boston Crusaders Drum & Bugle Corps, and marched with Spirit of Atlanta (2011-2012). He is Percussion Instructor and Program Coordinator for Flowery Branch High School and Batterie Coordinator for WGI Independent World Class group Equinox Percussion.

Tim Sexton is a marching arts educator who serves as a lead brass instructor with the Bluecoats and has previously taught on brass staff with The Cavaliers and on visual staff with the Madison Scouts and Crossmen. He is also a brass consultant for Battalion and Spirit of Atlanta. Sexton completed his Doctor of Musical Arts at the University of Utah, holds a Master of Music from Boise State University and a Bachelor of Arts in Music Education from Jacksonville State University, and performed internationally as a cast member with Blast! Brass Theater.

Aaron Wells served as a Co-Caption Manager for the Mandarins' 2021 Brass Team alongside Nicole Davis under Caption Head Patrick Keeley. The brass team was announced in October 2020. The Mandarins described the instructional staff as bringing a wealth of knowledge and experience to the organization.

Angelo Makropoulos is a music educator and percussionist from the south Chicago suburbs. He has been on sound and percussion staff at the Phantom Regiment Drum and Bugle Corps since 2018 and also serves as an audio engineer at the Santa Clara Vanguard Drum and Bugle Corps. He is an alumnus of the Madison Scouts Drum and Bugle Corps and holds a Bachelor's degree in Music Education from Western Illinois University.

Bill Muter is a multi-instrumentalist, best-selling author, composer, and clinician known for his work on tuba. He has worked with the Boston Crusaders (brass staff), Crossmen (pedagogy coordinator, brass staff), and Colts Drum and Bugle Corps (brass staff), and was also the caption head for WGI Gold Medalist Stryke Wynds.
Brandt Wright served as a Color Guard Choreographer for the Troopers Drum and Bugle Corps in 2018, listed in the corps' souvenir yearbook staff roster.

Carlos Martinez is a visual instructor from Mesa, Arizona who was a performing member with The Academy before teaching. He has taught Pacific Crest, Oregon Crusaders, Blue Stars, and Phenom during the summer, and served on the visual staff of Crossmen in 2022.

Chad Pence (1977–2023) was a high school band director and drum corps staff member for the Boston Crusaders, where he was affectionately known to students as 'Papa Pence.' Former students remembered him as deeply passionate about music and exceptionally dedicated to his students' growth as musicians.

Christopher Whyte has an extensive background in marching percussion. He performed with the Blue Devils, Bluecoats, and Seattle Cascades. He served as an instructor and designer for the Madison Scouts, Seattle Cascades, and Oregon Crusaders.

Evan Brown is an active sound and amplification designer in the marching arts. He has worked with Phantom Regiment since 2015, and has also held positions with The Cadets and Oregon Crusaders. He holds a Bachelor of Arts in Music from Slippery Rock University and works as the EDU Market Manager for Presonus Audio Electronics.
Felix Hernandez served as Visual Caption Head for Genesis Drum and Bugle Corps for the 2022 season, after having served as a visual consultant for the corps in 2021.

James Catherall is Lead Audio Engineer at Pacific Crest, where he handles sound design, percussion composition, and arrangement. He marched DCI with Santa Clara Vanguard, Santa Clara Vanguard Cadets, Blue Devils, and the Colts, and WGI with Pulse Open, Pulse, and RCC. As an educator he has worked with Broken City Percussion, Pulse Percussion, and Canyon High School among others.

Jimmy Nguyen is an educator, composer/arranger, sound designer, and clinician. He has worked with the Blue Stars Drum and Bugle Corps and the Mandarins Drum and Bugle Corps. He holds a BA in Sociology from UC Riverside and an MS in Higher Education from CSU Fullerton. He performed with the Blue Devils, Pacific Crest, and RCC Indoor Percussion, earning DCI and WGI world championships.

Jen Barton has served as color guard caption head for Pacific Crest Drum Corps (2011–2013 and returning 2016), Spirit of Atlanta Drum Corps (2014–2015), and Phantom Regiment Drum Corps. She holds a degree in music education and is a freelance choreographer, educator, and adjudicator in the marching arts. She retired in 2022 from the color guard director position at Rouse HS in Leander, TX.

Dr. Jon Holloway is a horn player and brass pedagogue based in Portland, Oregon, who teaches drum corps and marching bands. He marched with the Mandarins drum corps and won DCI's Individual & Ensemble top Mellophone solo in 2008. He holds music degrees from the University of Nevada, Reno, New York University, and the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, and teaches at Mt. Hood Community College.

Joy Liu was a front ensemble performer with the Blue Devils Drum and Bugle Corps in 2010. She served as a Percussion Instructor at Carolina Crown Drum & Bugle Corps from January to August 2015. Since 2022, she has held management and directorship roles with RCC Indoor Percussion, a Blue Devils Performing Arts program, currently serving as Program Director.
